original_test_intent: Verify insertion of the approved NVMe SSD produces the platform-defined physical Present/power LED state in the specified backplane slot.
original_method: A qualified operator inserts the mapped SSD under the approved service procedure and records the physical LED; the agent correlates secure controller/OS/BMC state without substituting another indicator.
manual_activity: Engineer resolves scope and LED semantics; qualified operator inserts and observes the exact mapped SSD; agent records complete mapping and health evidence.
required_inputs: Decision on SAS/SATA identity versus literal NVMe Present-LED scope
Platform Present/power LED state, color and timing specification
Supported insertion/hot-swap or powered-off data/RAID recovery procedure
Qualified operator, camera, secure controller/BMC access and OOB
safety_requirements: Verify the physical target and supported insertion state before handling
Keep boot, mounted, production and unsafe array members out of scope
Stop on wrong LED/slot, ambiguous selector, damage, RAID/filesystem/thermal/power/BMC error or access loss
Restore any approved query/indicator state and preserve logs
Do not use blind raw IPMI or treat Locate as Present
agent_execution_scope: Capture empty-slot and inserted stable identity/topology/health state
Record documented read-only controller/BMC corroboration if approved
Synchronize operator photo/timestamp with enumeration and logs
Do not insert hardware, assert visual proof, issue raw commands or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve scope and approve LED matrix, mapping and service plan
Provide qualified operator and recovery ownership
Review physical plus corroborative evidence and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Controller Locate or raw IPMI may address a different LED and target; lsblk cannot establish the physical Present/power state.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only a documented target-specific Present/status query as corroboration, paired with the operator's physical insertion and photo evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: NVMe insertion, Present-LED inspection, system-spec Criteria and source 15/8 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture empty-versus-inserted physical Present state for the exact mapped SSD with stable topology and health evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds indicator-semantic separation, secure targeting and recovery without altering the insertion trigger.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Automation corroborates logical state; physical LED observation remains manual.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Present may be a passive hardware state with no trustworthy software readback.

project_override_considerations: The project must resolve whether the SAS/SATA grouping is merely taxonomy or requires different hardware; only its approved Present/power semantics may govern acceptance.
expected_evidence: Scope decision and approved Present/power LED matrix
Operator identity, insertion timestamp and empty/inserted photos
Complete pre/post inventory, RAID/mount/health and PCI/sysfs evidence
Final approved state, recovery notes and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Test Set and Items retain SAS/SATA wording while the actual Procedure explicitly inserts an NVMe SSD; the authoritative hardware scope is unresolved although the Present-LED trigger is clear.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Scope decision, LED specification, operator and mapping are pending inputs; static review is complete and does not block later cases.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row113 Wistron-Storage-00096-V002: decide whether the authoritative target is the literal NVMe SSD Present/power LED despite SAS/SATA grouping, a SAS/SATA Present-LED test, or separate variants; provide exact LED state/color/timing, serial-to-backplane/enclosure/slot/controller map, supported insertion method and recovery. Locate/raw IPMI must not substitute for Present behavior.

review_improvement: Separates passive Present/power evidence from commanded Locate, exposes the hardware-scope conflict and binds observation to one stable physical identity.
independent_technical_reasoning: Present/power indication is normally driven by physical occupancy or power state, whereas Locate is an explicit service command. A successful Locate command can therefore illuminate the correct or wrong lamp without proving the insertion-driven Present behavior; the operator must observe the exact mapped bay under the approved state transition.
